name: screenlasso
description: Prepare images for Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube and the web, or convert them to WebP, AVIF, JPEG, PNG or HEIC, with the ScreenLasso app on your Mac. Images never leave your Mac.

access_key.title: ScreenLasso key
access_key.description: Copy it from ScreenLasso › Settings › AI Agents, with Let AI agents use ScreenLasso turned on.
